why: I checked all 11 expect lines against both must_not items. Item 1: every line can be checked at the PR head before merge. The checks are `npm ci` with the committed lock file, running `npx --no-install jsonl-lint` on temp files, root `npm test`, and reading package.json and README. The only CI mention is the PR's own `test` check, which also runs before merge. Publishing is listed as a non-goal, not as something to expect. Item 2: a tool with no tests run by npm test would not meet the issue. One expect line requires "a `test` script running `node:test` tests that cover a clean file, a file with invalid rows ... and a missing file", and adds that "the root `npm test` runs them and passes". Its proof also checks that npm test no longer prints 'no workspaces under packages/'. Neither forbidden item appears.
